title: Night IR camera traps (LILA BC)
description: 204 real night infrared (monochrome) frames from fixed outdoor camera traps, 69.5 MB (69478612 bytes) in total: 14 with vehicles, 30 dogs, 30 cats, 30 raccoons (by first scored class), 20 with only other wildlife (ignore regions) and 80 empty frames (hard negatives: vegetation, rocks, IR glare). Sources: Caltech Camera Traps (162; capture time 20:00-05:00), ENA24-detection (37) and NACTI (5); every frame passes the grayscale (IR) test (chroma spread < 3.0/255). NACTI person boxes are included (person is scored). Vehicle (ENA24, NACTI) and car (CCT) boxes are scored as car. Raccoon is scored only for models that have the class; for other models raccoons, like the other wildlife boxes (opossum, skunk, coyote, deer, ...), are ignore regions for their animal classes (a cat box on a raccoon is neither right nor wrong). Camera-trap viewpoints are low and close (not a mounted CCTV view). LILA's empty labels can miss small animals; the empty frames were screened by hand.
